results.title: Fish Audio Launches Drama 3: Direct AI Voices in Plain Language, Control Every Word and Shift Emotion Mid-Sentence
results.content:
PALO ALTO, Calif., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fish Audio, one of the fastest-growing AI platforms building expressive text-to-speech, speech-to-text and voice cloning, today launched Drama 3. This text-to-speech model lets developers, studios, and creators direct a voice performance instead of simply generating one. Users describe the desired tone, pacing, and character in plain language, then shape the performance with line-by-line precision until it's right.

Fish Audio Logo

Built to give developers, studios, and creators unprecedented control over voice performance, Drama 3 is designed for a wide range of applications, including audio dramas and interactive media, audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, games and animation, AI companion experiences, and content creation platforms. A drama studio can direct a two-character argument as a single scene, an audiobook narrator can shift from calm to trembling mid-sentence, and a game team can fix even a single word of dialogue without re-rendering the clip. Simply put, the model turns voice AI from something teams generate into something they can easily direct and edit. [...] "Voice AI has gotten very good at generating speech. The next step is directing a performance," said Rissa Cao, co-founder and CEO of Fish Audio. "Drama 3 is our most emotive and controllable model yet. It puts creators in the director's chair: describe what you want in plain language, listen back, and adjust only the moments that aren't working. That matters most in long-form projects like audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, where one wrong word shouldn't mean regenerating a whole chapter."

results.title: Fish Audio's Drama 3 Lets Developers Direct AI Voices Like a Film Script | AlphaSignal
results.content:
Fish Audio has released Drama 3, a text-to-speech model designed to generate directed scenes from annotated scripts. Developers can place natural-language performance cues alongside dialogue, including instructions that change delivery within a sentence. The 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model is available as open weights on Hugging Face and through the Fish Audio API under the identifier `drama-3-preview`.

The launch follows a $52 million seed round and a company-reported user base of more than 15 million. Drama 3 is Fish Audio’s first flagship directable model released in the open-weight tier, giving teams the option to use a hosted endpoint or run the checkpoint on their own infrastructure.

## Direction lives in the script [...] Mid-line direction: A sentence can begin calmly and become panicked without generating separate takes.
 Multi-speaker scenes: Several characters can appear in one generation while retaining distinct voices.
 Audio inpainting: A selected word or segment can be regenerated while the surrounding audio remains in place.
 Long-form multilingual delivery: The model can preserve a voice across extended scripts, switch languages within a scene, and accept phoneme-level pronunciation controls.

results.content:
Instead of relying on basic voice presets, users can insert instructions directly into their scripts. A character might begin speaking calmly, become increasingly frustrated, and finish a sentence in a whisper, all without switching between separate recordings. Even synthetic actors now have to take direction.

Drama 3 also supports multi-character conversations and 83 languages. Instructions can be applied to individual words or passages, allowing creators to emphasize specific expressions without changing the rest of the script.
